name: This Fruit Could Bite Back
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
narrative.objectives: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
narrative.offerRewardText: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
